title: Maktub (2011 film)

infobox.Production company: Sonrisas que Hacen Magia Producciones AIE

production_companies: Sonrisas que Hacen Magia Producciones AIE

text.lead: Maktub is a 2011 Spanish comedy-drama film directed by Paco Arango (in his directorial debut feature). Its cast features Diego Peretti, Aitana Sánchez-Gijón, Goya Toledo, Andoni Hernández, Laura Esquivel, and Jorge Garcia, among others.
text.plot: A couple in marital crisis formed by Manolo and Beatriz meet Antonio, a Canarian boy with cancer full of zest for life, thereby changing Manolo's life forever.
text.cast:
- Diego Peretti as Manolo
- Aitana Sánchez-Gijón as Beatriz
- Goya Toledo as Mariluz
- Andoni Hernández as Antonio
- Rosa María Sardá as Guadalupe
- Amparo Baró as Merche
- Mariví Bilbao as Puri
- Arón Piper as Iñaki
- Sara Jiménez as Elena
- Laura Esquivel as Linda
- Enrique Villén as Raimundo
- Oriol Tarrasón
- Fátima Baeza
- Jorge Garcia as Carlos
text.production: The film is a Sonrisas que Hacen Magia Producciones AIE production, with the collaboration of Antena 3. Shooting locations included El Guincho (Garachico).
text.release: Distributed by Warner Bros. Pictures, the film was released theatrically in Spain on 16 December 2011.
text.reception:
Jordi Costa of El País wrote that "the worst thing about 'Maktub' is not only its aggressive combination of television aesthetics and sentimentality" "but its thinly disguised status as promotional fiction".
Irene Crespo of Cinemanía rated the film 2 out of 5 stars deeming it to be a "family fable crammed with carols and faith".
